# TECTONIC HVAC • MEP • ENGINEERING
> GCC Turnkey Infrastructure Contracting: Integrated HVAC, Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing, and Building Management Systems for commercial, industrial, healthcare, and hospitality megaprojects across UAE, Saudi Arabia, and Qatar.

## Core Engineering Disciplines
1. HVAC & District Cooling: Central chilled water substations (ETS), magnetic levitation chillers, high-delta T loops, custom AHUs with HEPA filtration, precision computer room air conditioning (CRAC), VRF/VRV systems, acoustic silencer networks, and DW144 insulated ductwork.
2. Mechanical Systems: Hydronic piping networks, industrial plant heat rejection systems, boiler plants, compressed air infrastructure, and vibration attenuation.
3. Electrical MV/LV: 11kV/33kV transformer substations, smart busbar trunking, power distribution panels, standby UPS grids, and smart power telemetry.
4. Plumbing & Public Health: Potable water booster plants, high-rise drainage stack attenuation, solar domestic hot water networks, greywater reclamation, and RO plants.
5. Fire Protection: UL/FM certified fire pumping units, pre-action sprinkler systems, clean agent gaseous suppression (FM-200/Novec 1230), and smoke evacuation.
6. Building Management Systems (BMS): BACnet IP supervisory architecture, direct digital controls (DDC), energy sub-metering grids, and algorithmic chiller plant optimization.
7. Testing, Adjusting & Balancing (TAB): NEBB & CSA standard hydronic balancing, air duct leakage testing (DW143), thermographic electrical surveys, and full system black-building runs.
8. Operation & Maintenance (O&M): Predictive maintenance programs, vibration baseline analysis, on-site certified engineering crews, and guaranteed 2-hour SLA response.

## Key Projects
- Twin Commercial Towers & Financial Center (Dubai): 4,500 TR district cooling, MV 11kV distribution, LEED Platinum.
- Luxury Coastal Resort & Superyacht Marina (Doha): Anti-corrosion marine HVAC, shore-power MV, GSAS 5-Star.
- Regional Specialty Medical Center & Research Wing (Riyadh): 24 laminar flow operating theatres, HTM 03-01 HVAC, JCI compliant.
- Advanced Logistics & Cold Storage Facility (Abu Dhabi KIZAD): Ammonia-free CO2 cascade refrigeration, ESFR sprinklers, 2.5 MW backup diesel power.

- Electrical: IEEE, IEC 61439, DEWA Regulations, SEC Standards, Kahramaa Regulations
- Fire Protection: NFPA 13, NFPA 20, NFPA 72, UAE Fire & Life Safety Code, SASO
